R596.note: Removing @csrf_exempt restores CsrfViewMiddleware for this view; the 405/401/queued paths and BillingMailer call are byte-identical to the original.

R597.note: bin2hex(random_bytes(32)) is the correct CSPRNG replacement; the token becomes a 64-char hex string instead of a 6-digit int and the unused client_seed is dropped, both inherent to the fix and stated.

R598.note: ValidAlgorithms = HS256 pins the accepted algorithm on TokenValidationParameters, which is what the finding asks for; the write-up states plainly that the array must be changed if the issuer signs HS384/HS512.

R599.note: Keeps the textual check and adds a toRealPath() containment check on the entry's parent, closing symlink escape; createDirectories is stated and is what makes nested entries extract at all, though it runs before the symlink check so a directory could be created outside destination before rejection.

R600.note: getCanonicalPath containment against base + File.separator closes traversal after the double decode; the extra startsWith("/") reject only excludes names no flat filename can have, though the explanation's claim that new File(parent, child) lets an absolute child win is wrong for Java.

R601.note: The /bin/ls branch is closed, but the Windows branch still hands data to cmd.exe /c, which re-parses it: I ran the write-up's exact cmdArray on JDK 26 in a scratch dir with data="x&.\marker.bat" and the injected command executed (marker file written), since Java only quotes args containing space/tab/</>.

R602.note: Parameterized QueryRow with a ? placeholder; query shape, scan and both response paths unchanged, and the driver-dependence of ? vs $1 is stated.

R603.note: Detail moved to log.Printf and the client gets a generic 500 body; nothing else about the handler or the success path changes.

R604.note: RequireAuthorization() on the MapDelete registration is the per-endpoint metadata Minimal APIs need, matching the [Authorize] the sibling controller already carries; authenticated callers are unaffected.

R605.note: Rejecting CR/LF before the socket write closes IMAP command injection and rejects nothing a real mailbox name may contain; a missing folder parameter now NPEs where the original sent "a1 SELECT null", an undisclosed but degenerate edge.

R606.note: csrfTokenRequestHandler(new CsrfTokenRequestAttributeHandler()) aligns the handler with the raw value CookieCsrfTokenRepository writes, so SPA requests validate instead of 403ing; it silently opts out of BREACH masking (the Xor handler with csrfRequestAttributeName null keeps it) and the stated rationale misdescribes the defect.

R607.note: Traversal is closed by the toRealPath base plus Path.startsWith containment, but the fix also bans any path separator in the cookie value and drops URLDecoder.decode, so nested names and percent-encoded names the original wrote are now rejected or written literally - both stated, but they narrow what a legitimate caller can supply.

R608.note: Secure closes the reported weakness; HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax are stated extra hardening on a session cookie no JavaScript or cross-site POST needs, and the handler's status and error path are unchanged.

R609.note: FromSqlInterpolated parameterizes both tenantId and the pre-built %term% pattern, preserving the tenant filter, contains-style match, async List<Product> return and the empty-term behaviour.
